 Print SSC JE, CPO 2026 exam dates revised The Staff Selection Commission ( SSC ) has revised the examination dates for the Junior Engineer (JE) Examination 2026 and the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination 2026. The Commission issued a notice revising the schedule announced in its earlier notice. According to the revised schedule, the SSC Junior Engineer Examination 2026 will be conducted in two phases in November and December. Meanwhile, the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination 2026 will be held from November 23 to November 28. Candidates preparing for these examinations are advised to check the revised dates and plan their preparation accordingly. SSC JE 2026 revised exam dates
 As per the latest notice, the Junior Engineer Examination 2026 Paper-I, which will be conducted in Computer-Based Examination (CBE) mode, is scheduled for November 2 to November 6, 2026, and November 30 to December 1, 2026. Candidates should take note of both examination windows while preparing for the test. SSC CPO 2026 revised exam dates
 The Commission has also revised the schedule for the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination 202, or commonly known as SSC CPO examination. The examination will be conducted in Computer-Based Examination mode from November 23 to November 28, 2026. Candidates appearing for this examination should refer to the revised schedule before making any plans related to the examination. SSC advises candidates to check official website
 The Commission has advised candidates to visit its official website at regular intervals for further updates regarding the examinations. Candidates should refer to the latest official notices for any additional information or changes to the examination schedule. Read the official notice here.
